args.summary: After deploying v2.3.1 to all production regions, checkout-api began failing health checks with an elevated error rate of ~18%. The service was rolled back in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent version with a healthy production track record. The rollback rollout completed and was verified (status: rolled_out, execution_state: VERIFIED). Root cause of v2.3.1 failure is not yet known and requires investigation by the owning team.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` v2.3.1 was failing health checks across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Release history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent version that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was only ever in staging and was unhealthy there).
2. **Rolled back**: All three production regions are now running **v2.3.0** — the rollback rollout completed and was verified. No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production.
3. **Incident opened**: **INC-0001 (SEV2)** for checkout-api, documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and that root cause investigation is needed. The on-call engineer has been paged.

You may want to verify health/error rates have recovered post-rollback and follow up with the team that shipped v2.3.1.
